description: Quote-loop profile for buying from Israeli sellers. Absorbed from israel-shopping:ask-store (2026-11-23).

language.name: Hebrew
language.notes: Model names, part numbers and brand names stay in Latin script. 2-4 lines per message; no long specs, no English paragraphs.

phone.notes: A 05x mobile on a contact page is usually WhatsApp. Some stores run WhatsApp Business on a 02/03/04/08/09 landline; the site's WhatsApp button shows which.

find: a wa.me/<number> or api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=<number> link on the product or contact page (take only the digits, not the prefilled text)
a 05x mobile number on the contact page
a WhatsApp Business landline shown by the site's WhatsApp button
the terms / privacy page (often has the company email and ח.פ.)

channel_order.notes: Give the user a call script; the agent does not phone.

business_hours.notes: Approximate. Friday is mornings only, Saturday (Shabbat) closed. Expect closures on Jewish holidays and their eves.

search.notes: If results are thin, swap מחיר for במלאי (in stock) or יבואן (importer). The built-in web search is US-biased and often ignores site:, so run these in Google through a real browser or a search API that honours site:. For a full product search hand off to israel-shopping:find-product.

reputable_signals: manufacturer or official Israeli importer (יבואן רשמי)
specialist with a real showroom or workshop and a track record in the category
company number (ח.פ.) and a physical address on the site
reviews beyond the price-comparison site (e.g. Google Maps)
aggregator_signals: Zap storefront selling many unrelated categories
no ח.פ. or address on the site
listing text identical to another storefront (same operator)
adjacent store IDs on the same platform with the same wording

first_contact:
שלום, אני מחפש/ת <מוצר> ל<שימוש בשורה אחת>, תקציב בערך <₪>.
מה הייתם ממליצים? שוקל/ת את <דגם>, יש אצלכם במלאי?
חדש באריזה סגורה? כמה עולה משלוח ל<עיר> ותוך כמה ימים?
תודה!

היי, מתעניין/ת ב<דגם> (או משהו דומה) ל<שימוש>. מה הייתם ממליצים?
יש במלאי, חדש ולא תצוגה? מחיר כולל משלוח ל<עיר>?
אפשר לחזור אליי ל<טלפון>. תודה!

ערב טוב, אני צריך/ה <מוצר> ש<דרישת התאמה>. <דגם> מתאים לזה לדעתכם?
אם כן, יש במלאי וכמה זמן משלוח ל<עיר>? מדובר בחדש באריזה?
תודה רבה
chase: שלום שוב, רציתי לבדוק לגבי ההודעה הקודמת על <דגם>. תודה!
היי, מחכה לתשובה לגבי <דגם> (מלאי ומחיר). תודה!
holding_reply: תודה רבה! אחזור אליכם לגבי ההזמנה.
templates.notes: Templates are starting points. Vary the wording for every seller: identical bulk messages to strangers get WhatsApp accounts banned.

cultural_notes: Returns are hard in practice, whatever the law allows: expect in-person returns, credit notes or restocking deductions rather than a smooth refund. Treat an Israeli purchase as final unless the seller's return terms are known and good.
So a seller's pre-sale answer previews its after-sale service: grade responsiveness and straightness, not only price.
Domestic delivery is often unreliable: missed windows, rescheduled drop-offs, 'in stock' listings that are not on the shelf. Get stock and delivery time confirmed in writing.
Prefer the option that is right first time over the cheapest one that might be. Do not recommend a 'buy it, return it if it doesn't work' gamble from an Israeli store.
Staff often reply from a personal Gmail or WhatsApp number rather than the store's address.
